observed: Nebius furnished a September 8, 2026 Form 6-K to the SEC stating that Exhibit 99.1 announces the Palantir-Nebius partnership to deliver a complete sovereign AI stack to Palantir customers.
The regulatory filing independently anchors the partnership announcement in Nebius's SEC reporting lineage rather than relying only on the issuer newsroom copy.

factors.name: sovereignEnterpriseDistribution
factors.basis: The SEC-filed partnership disclosure corroborates a distribution path through Palantir commercial customers, while not establishing realized revenue or utilization.

risks: A filed partnership announcement is evidence that the relationship was formally disclosed, not evidence of committed customer spend, realized utilization, margin, or conversion.
unknowns: No committed revenue, customer count, utilization, margin contribution, or deployment volume is disclosed in the 6-K cover filing.

observed: The SEC filing confirms that Nebius formally furnished the September 8 partnership announcement as Exhibit 99.1.

factors.name: commercialChannelExecution
factors.basis: Formal SEC disclosure corroborates that the announced Palantir channel relationship is an issuer-reported corporate event, but execution economics remain unreported.

risks: Formal disclosure should not be converted into numeric underwriting without source-addressed operating or financial evidence.
unknowns: Whether the partnership converts into material revenue, durable customer adoption, or attractive unit economics remains unknown.

lineage.origin: SEC EDGAR Form 6-K furnished by Nebius Group N.V.
